title: Great Diplomacy
author: Pr1nted
$comment: A trumpet lament over a funeral drum and a tolling bell -- the title is the irony. Placed at the bleakest point in the library, but at LOW tension on purpose: an empire coming apart after the fighting stopped, not during it. That separation is what keeps March to the Death owning a war being lost and hands this one the aftermath, when the map is much smaller and nothing is being shot at.
